title: Sheepdog
excerpt: Calm workspace for cloud coding agents.
content_html:
Early access

Fast and beautiful workspace for cloud coding agents.

Tend, drive, and manage your herd of coding agents from anywhere.

Get started

Features

  • 01

    Bring your own subscriptions

    Use your Claude Code and Codex subscriptions. Add several, and tasks switch when one hits its limit.

  • 02

    Workspaces with repos, MCPs and skills

    Put a project’s repos, MCP servers, skills and setup script together. Every task in it gets them all.

  • 03

    A new machine for each task

    Each task gets a fresh cloud machine set up from its workspace. Preview its dev servers in a click.

  • 04

    Work with your entire team

    Share a task with teammates, or the whole workspace, and they can follow it and send it a message. Keep a workspace to the people who need it.

  • 05

    Super fast with keyboard shortcuts

    Start tasks, switch between them and send messages without reaching for the mouse.

  • 06

    On the go from your phone

    Add Sheepdog to your home screen to open it like an app, and get notified when an agent finishes.

Pricing

  • Trial

    $2

    Once.

    • Invite your team
    • Unlimited workspaces
    • 20 hours of machine time, with no time limit
    • 50 tasks
    Get started

  • Pro

    $20

    Per month.

    • Just you
    • Unlimited workspaces
    • 250 hours of machine time a month
    • No limit on new tasks
    Get started

  • Teams

    $40

    Per member. Per month.

    • Unlimited members
    • Unlimited workspaces, for the whole team or chosen members
    • 400 hours of machine time a month per member, shared across the team
    • No limit on new tasks
    • A Slack Connect channel with the Sheepdog team
    Get started

Enterprise

Custom

Priced for your team.

Run Sheepdog in your own cloud.

Everything in Teams, with your tasks' machines in your own AWS, GCP or Azure account, so your code never leaves your cloud. Bring your own AI provider keys, and get dedicated support, onboarding and a contract that fits how your company buys.

Contact us
